WORKS PERFECTLY - TEETH AND GUMS FEEL CLEANER
This is the third Norelco Sonic toothbrush I have owend.  After many years of good service, the other two batteries finally wore out.  The 4100 series is, of course, an advanced version of the ones I used befrore and has been performing even better.  I am very pleased with this purchase and expect better dental reports as it has been over 5 years since the previous one finally would not accept a battery charge - the batteries are not replaceable (sealed).  While the Owner's Manual states that you can leave the brush on the charger, I had done that with the first two and I think that is why the batteries eventually built up a resistance to continued charging.  This one is allowed to sit on the counter (flat bottom is stable and the brush air dries).  On the first charge, I got 3 weeks of daily use before it indicated a need for a recharge.
Yes, I recommend this product

features.name: Removes plaque 3x better*
features.description: The Sonicare electric toothbrush with advanced sonicare technology is clinically proven to remove plaque up to 3X better* than a manual toothbrush. It removes plaque from your teeth and along the gum line while protecting your gums.

features.name: Easy-Start
features.description: Our Easy-Start program gives you the option of a gradual, gentle increase in brushing power the first 14 times you use your new toothbrush.

features.name: SmartTimer and QuadPacer
features.description: 2 minute SmarTimer and 30-second QuadPacer guide you to brush for the recommended time in all areas of your mouth to ensure a complete clean.

features.name: Protects your gums
features.description: Built-in pressure sensor automatically detects pressure you apply, warns you, and reduces the toothbrush vibrations automatically to help protect your gums. The toothbrush will make a pulsing sound as a reminder to ease off the pressure. 7 out of 10 people found this feature helped them become better brushers.

features.name: Advanced Sonicare Technology
features.description: Powerful bristle vibrations drive microbubbles deep between your teeth and along your gum line for a refreshing experience. You will get two month's worth of manual brushing in just 2 minutes.** 31000 brush strokes per minute gently clean your teeth, break up plaque, and sweep it away for an exceptional daily clean.

features.name: Long lasting battery life
features.description: Battery life lasts up to 14 days so you can go long periods without charging.

features.name: Designed around you
features.description: Slim, light-weight, and ergonomic design makes the toothbrush easy to hold and use so that you can get an amazing clean without any strain.

features.name: 2 intensity settings
features.description: Switch between 2 intensity settings to make the brushing session comfortable for you.
